_comment: 1-GPU probe: confirms the image pulls and /share (CFS) mounts at the same path as locally, before spending a real run. cfsInstanceId/cfsMountPoint are required by CreateJob even though DescribeJob reads them back blank.
name: cfs-share-smoke
command: bash -c 'ls /share && df -hT /share && nvidia-smi && python -c "import torch;print(torch.__version__, torch.cuda.device_count())"'
